notes: The BS program page (catalogs.buffalo.edu poid=5856) came back empty on fetch, so the course list was assembled from search-result snippets of the 2025-26 catalog (CSE 115, 116, 191, 220, 250, 341, 331 and 442 in the core), the SEAS program page (senior year takes software engineering and operating systems), and the department course catalog. CSE 331 is the required algorithms course. The department lists CSE 442 as the required software engineering course.
